Vande Bharat Express trial and new service extensions announced

A Vande Bharat Express trial between Yesvantpur (Bengaluru) and Mangaluru Central is scheduled for 5 September. The trial’s one‑way run time is projected at 8 hours 20 minutes, with the return journey expected to be completed in 8 hours. Indian Railways also announced that the Vande Bharat Express will make a scheduled halt at Anantnag railway station in Jammu and Kashmir by the end of September. Local stakeholders expressed approval of the Anantnag halt. Additionally, a new Vande Bharat service linking Surat and Udaipur has been detailed, with a travel time of approximately 7.5 hours and a list of intermediate stops. The announcements were reported by multiple Indian news outlets.
